comment: This man is the nicest person ever and its virtually impossible to fail. He gives practice tests before the real tests and they are the exact same problems just with different numbers. He is a good teacher and really understanding towards his students.

Vikram is AWESOME. Jeez i wish i could take him for Calc 212! He's your stereotypical professor when it comes to caring- he doesn't take attendance, care if you're there, it's up to you to go to him for make up and help. but he's SUCH a good professor. he knows how to teach!! I'm horrible at math, but he explains it so we all understand. 100% rec.
Don't skip classes and pay attention during lectures and you will get an A. Tests are very similar to the homework, as long as you're good with homework you'll ace the class.
Too easy for a math 300 course. Only reason I didnt give a 5. Otherwise a great course and well taught. Enjoyed every bit of it but wished it was more challenging.
